test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b1e7e21884b45474f1f38757ceb61f4ddd533afc5bcafed6b2fafc609f6aa8b.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately diagonal elements in the box shifts in the downward clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately rest of the elements except diagonal elements shifts in the clockwise direction. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21344428665a0539e4f893139935f73f0cb6f96fc0dedab80533c7f6c9850269.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately first column and third column elements shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second column elements shifts in the downward clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ec673d4fd668b06f659c56119ae187a8e3946afb6cbedf5224f5ebc5a3d7b4d.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64dcf308fa4ac2b6d139303cefaaac47db2a55e1b345c441a87a6bd6137a0691.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
